existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Fees for paper copies shall not exceed 25 cents per photocopy not exceeding 9 by 14 inches, unless a different fee is prescribed by statute.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Paper photocopy up to 9x14 inches provided
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: except when a different fee is otherwise prescribed by statute: (1) the fees for paper copies of records shall not exceed twenty-five cents per photocopy not in excess of nine inches by fourteen inches, or the actual cost of reproducing any other record in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (c) of this subdivision.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Ceiling, not a fixed rate: the city sets its actual per-page fee up to $0.25. A statute-specified different fee overrides this ceiling.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Actual cost of reproduction for other records
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For records other than 9x14 paper photocopies, the fee shall not exceed the actual cost of reproduction determined under § 87(1)(c).
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Reproduction of a record that is not a 9x14 paper photocopy
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: ...or the actual cost of reproducing any other record in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (c) of this subdivision.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: 'Actual cost' is capped and its composition is fixed by § 87(1)(c) (NY-0027 through NY-0030).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: No fee for recently prepared identical electronic record
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Where an identical record was prepared for a prior request within the past six months and an electronic copy is available, the agency shall charge no fee except the actual cost of a storage device/media if provided.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Identical record prepared within past 6 months and electronic copy available
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: In the case where an identical record has been prepared for a previous request within the past 6 months and an electronic copy is available, an agency shall not charge a fee for the reproduction of such record, except for the actual cost of a storage device or media if one is provided to the requester in complying with such request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Fee fixed at $0 (plus media cost); 6-month lookback is the trigger condition.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Preparation labor billed at lowest-paid qualified employee's rate
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Actual reproduction cost may include only the hourly salary attributed to the lowest-paid agency employee who has the necessary skill to prepare the copy.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Copy preparation requires employee labor (subject to the 2-hour threshold)
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: In determining the actual cost of reproducing a record, an agency may include only: i. an amount equal to the hourly salary attributed to the lowest paid agency employee who has the necessary skill required to prepare a copy of the requested record;
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Basis is fixed by statute (lowest-paid qualified employee); the city supplies the actual wage figure as the operative value.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Two-hour preparation threshold for any labor fee
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: No preparation fee may be charged unless at least two hours of agency employee time is needed to prepare the copy.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Copy preparation requires agency employee time
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: ...no fee shall be charged unless at least two hours of agency employee time is needed to prepare a copy of the record requested.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Two-hour floor gates the labor fee entirely; fixed by statute.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Search time and administrative costs excluded from fee
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Preparing a copy shall not include search time or administrative costs; these may not be charged to the requester.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: ...preparing a copy shall not include search time or administrative costs, and no fee shall be charged unless at least two hours of agency employee time is needed to prepare a copy of the record requested.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Constrains the fee calculation — the recoverable labor is copy-preparation time only, not search/admin.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Outside professional service cost only when IT equipment inadequate
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The actual cost of engaging an outside professional service to prepare a copy may be included only when the agency's information technology equipment is inadequate to prepare the copy and the service is used.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Agency IT equipment inadequate; outside service used to prepare copy
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: iii. the actual cost to the agency of engaging an outside professional service to prepare a copy of a record, but only when an agency's information technology equipment is inadequate to prepare a copy, if such service is used to prepare the copy;
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Branch condition on recovering outside-service cost; ties to the no-burden-refusal rule (NY-0018).

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The requester shall be informed of the estimated cost of preparing the copy if more than two hours of employee time is needed or if an outside professional service would be retained.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Preparation needs more than 2 hours of employee time, or an outside service is to be retained
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: A person requesting a record shall be informed of the estimated cost of preparing a copy of the record if more than two hours of an agency employee's time is needed, or if an outside professional service would be retained to prepare a copy of the record.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Cost-estimate notice is a required communication before charging preparation fees.

fee.copy_rate_per_page.summary: Fees for paper copies shall not exceed 25 cents per photocopy not exceeding 9 by 14 inches, unless a different fee is prescribed by statute.

fee.labor_charge.summary: Actual reproduction cost may include only the hourly salary attributed to the lowest-paid agency employee who has the necessary skill to prepare the copy.
No preparation fee may be charged unless at least two hours of agency employee time is needed to prepare the copy.

fee.actual_cost_basis.summary: For records other than 9x14 paper photocopies, the fee shall not exceed the actual cost of reproduction determined under § 87(1)(c).

The actual cost of engaging an outside professional service to prepare a copy may be included only when the agency's information technology equipment is inadequate to prepare the copy and the service is used.

fee.no_charge_categories.summary: Where an identical record was prepared for a prior request within the past six months and an electronic copy is available, the agency shall charge no fee except the actual cost of a storage device/media if provided.
Preparing a copy shall not include search time or administrative costs; these may not be charged to the requester.
